items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: He used to come in. I went to the sisters of the Holy Family... And he used to give concerts for the sisters out there.

ctx.x: Well, what kind of music did you hear in Donaldsonville when you were growing up? Did they have dances there? Or?

Billika Sand. Did you hear Billika Sand? Sure. He used to come in. I went to the sisters of the Holy Family. She paid to him. Holy Family School out there. Holy Family Sisters from here. They had a school and that's where I went to school. And he used to give concerts for the sisters out there. Billika Sand. And who else used to come out there? Well, that was a main feature.
That was a main feature of him.
